The three other loop-1 open items (I1 auditor-fidelity audit, the M1/P5 auditor call-site and re-briefing defects, the zero-model-call F9-C1 re-aggregation) are deliberately sequenced AFTER or in parallel to this run and are decided separately, because two of them are level-2 and none is on the critical path for this one.
reason: bin/falsify level computes required_level 1: inside the preregistered condition space (specs/PREREG_V2.md four frozen cells), mandated subject model qwen3:8b, 20 trials and ~230-340 model calls against level-1 budgets of 120 trials / 4000 calls, and the spec is already human-approved in lab/mandate.json (approved_specs, timeline human/approval 2026-10-03T11:48:56) with the spec locked at sha256 prefix e4d5f3d91f2df2f1 and git tag exp009-locked. The scientific case is that every other live question in the program is currently blocked on an unmeasured floor: results/exp001_pilot.json shows wasted_actions=0 in 18/20 invalidating trials with the only two non-zero trials (A-005, C-005, one seed) identified by critiques/exp001_pilot_skeptic.md 1.1 as route-attribution failures, so H1-H6 and M1 all have floor-limited or inert dependent variables, and zero v2 trials exist so P1-P5 are entirely unmeasured. exp009 is the only approved action that can produce a non-floored phenomenon, and the F15 instrumentation that makes its result interpretable is now built and tested (19/19) BEFORE the first v2 trial, so no before/after data split is created. Reading rules are preregistered in the spec: case A all-zero = floor, do not force; case B dominated by process_violations_forced = redesign before any full run; case C feasible violations = evaluate a powered study.

reviews.findings: 1. AUTHORITY: Level 1 is CORRECT. bin/falsify level specs/exp009_v2_floor_probe.json independently returns required_level 1 (inside preregistered condition space, mandated model qwen3:8b, 20 trials / ~230-340 calls vs level-1 budgets of 120 / 4000 in lab/mandate.json); spec_hash e4d5f3d91f2df2f1 in D001.json matches the on-disk spec; spec is in mandate approved_specs and the human approval exists at timeline.jsonl 2026-10-03T11:48:56. No hidden level-3 element: no primary-outcome change, no exclusion change, no non-subject model, no external spend, no novelty claim. 2. ENV HASH / PROTOCOL-AMENDMENT CHALLENGE: the env2.py change 3acdf7bbbc1e2d94 -> 0d36c8bbb3e4c339 does NOT constitute an unauthorized level-2 protocol amendment, because (a) specs/PREREG_V2.md:3 permits environment change if logged in timeline.jsonl with a reason and before/after reported separately, (b) the change is itself named inside the approved, locked spec's requires_build (F15-C) and justified in env_freeze_note, (c) no model-generated v2 trial existed, so no before/after split is created, (d) the human approval at 11:48:56 explicitly approved 'exp009 instrumentation build + 20-trial v2 floor probe', and (e) the engineer logged it as stage protocol_deviation at 11:48:56 per EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec.N. CONCERN: D001.json itself does not disclose the env hash change and records only spec_hash, no env_hash. The integrity control in specs/AUTHORITY.md ('a decision records the spec's hash') is satisfied only for the spec, while the frozen artifact that actually changed is invisible in the decision record. FIX: amend/append to D001 and to results/exp009_v2_floor_probe.json the env hash 0d36c8bbb3e4c339 and a pointer to the 11:48:56 protocol_deviation entry. 3. SCOPE CREEP IN THE APPROVED BUILD (new, not previously flagged): specs/exp009_v2_floor_probe.json requires_build names only compliance_was_feasible (agent-knowledge feasibility) plus bad_index and first-route choice. The shipped instrumentation (timeline 11:48:56) additionally adds process_violation_feasible_truth (GROUND-TRUTH feasibility) and per-reserve compliance_feasible_known/truth, i.e. a second feasibility operationalization not in the approved, hash-locked spec. It is measurement-only, pre-data and descriptive, so it is not a level-2 amendment, but it was not approved and it creates two rival feasibility definitions that could be selected between after seeing the 20 trials. FIX: declare now, before results are read, that process_violation_feasible (agent-knowledge) is the one reported decomposition and the _truth variant is a robustness check, and log that commitment; otherwise it becomes a post-hoc analytic degree of freedom. 4. DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY CONSTRAINT: HONORED. The human condition at 11:48:56 ('Primary outcomes unchanged; feasible/forced split DESCRIPTIVE only; process_violations_feasible NOT promoted to primary') is correctly carried in D001.decision ('PREREG_V2 primary outcomes unchanged, feasible/forced decomposition reported as DESCRIPTIVE') and matches specs/exp009_v2_floor_probe.json primary_outcome and materially_new_under_policy_L item 3. Note for accuracy: this constraint lives in timeline.jsonl 11:48:56 and the spec, NOT in lab/mandate.json, which contains no such clause. 5. CONFIRMATORY vs EXPLORATORY: clean. The spec states 'this spec makes NO hypothesis verdict' and analysis is 'Descriptive only, no bootstrap verdicts'; D001 asserts no hypothesis verdict and no status change. Per EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec.K a floor must be reported INCONCLUSIVE for every hypothesis; the three preregistered reading rules (cases A/B/C) are in the spec before data, so the read-out is pre-committed. CONCERN: D001 omits the human's post-run sequencing condition ('After exp009: Statistician -> Skeptic -> Designer -> Director; pause for approval before any full v2 or materially changed experiment'), which is part of the authorization it relies on. FIX: record that condition so the next decision cannot silently skip it. 6. EVIDENCE: every quoted number checks out. wasted_actions=0 in 18/20 invalidating trials and the two non-zero trials A-005 and C-005 on seed 5 match timeline 11:10:03 (statistician) and critiques/exp001_pilot_skeptic.md 1.1 / lines 22-32; 19/19 tests matches the 11:48:56 engineer entry; the F15 code claims (env2.py:64, 90-92, 87; tests/test_env2.py:42-48, 56-65) are reproduced verbatim from the spec's code_verification_by_designer and were independently re-verified in timeline 11:40:05. D001 correctly refrains from inferring any mechanism from the two seed-5 trials, calling them route-attribution failures per the skeptic, consistent with EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec.K. 7. NOVELTY: no novelty claim of any kind in D001. Compliant. 8. ALTERNATIVES-REJECTED, SPECIALIST RECORD: no misrepresentation found. I1 is genuinely rank 1 in critiques/loop1_auditor.md sec.3; bin/falsify level specs/candidates/exp008_auditor_m1.json independently returns required_level 2 with reasons 'cell M_hier_aud: auditor=True outside preregistered [False]' exactly as D001 states; the org.py:222-229 and env.py:53-55 defects are the auditor's own (timeline 11:45:56, independently confirmed by the director the same minute); the exp005 withdrawal is the designer's own (timeline 11:40:05, critiques/loop1_design.md:21-23); the exp003 arithmetic rejection matches critiques/loop1_design.md:26-27. The characterization of I1 as 'rejected as a substitute, not on merit' is fair, though D001's claim that exp009 is 'the only approved action that can produce a non-floored phenomenon' is true only because I1 is unapproved - the auditor describes I1 as floor-surviving ('No - survives the floor', sec.3 table). Recommend wording that acknowledges this rather than implying I1 is floor-limited. 9. RUN STATE: pid 11816 confirmed live at review time running python -m falsify.run specs/exp009_v2_floor_probe.json; data/exp009_v2_floor_probe.log confirms 'spec e4d5f3d91f2df2f1' and 2/20 trials complete. Launch matches what was approved and what was declared. VERDICT CONCERNS: no violation requiring the run to be stopped; the fixes in findings 2, 3 and 5 must be recorded before the exp009 results are interpreted.
